encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}\!\left[\bigl(M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})-\alpha\bigr)^{2}\right]\;\leq\;\frac{L_{Lip}(1+\gamma)}{\gamma}\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[\bigl|\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\bigr|\right]+\frac{L_{Lip}\gamma}{2},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS3.p2.2" class="ltx_p">where the expectation is taken with respect to the stationary distribution of the process.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS3.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS3.p3.1" class="ltx_p">We begin from the <math id="A1.SS3.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>τ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau</annotation></semantics></math>-delayed recursion:</p>
<table id="A1.Ex30" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<p id="A1.SS3.p3.2" class="ltx_p">Subtracting <math id="A1.SS3.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}</annotation></semantics></math> and squaring both sides gives</p>

<section id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Bounding the cross term <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha-\texttt{err}_{t})(\alpha_{t}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})\right]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_monospace">err</mtext><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha-\texttt{err}_{t})(\alpha_{t}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})\right]</annotation></semantics></math>:</h4>

<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">By the law of total expectation and the definition of <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="M(\cdot\mid A_{t})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M(\cdot\mid A_{t})</annotation></semantics></math>, noting that
<math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\mathbb{E}[\texttt{err}_{t}\mid A_{t},\alpha_{t}]=M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_monospace">err</mtext><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[\texttt{err}_{t}\mid A_{t},\alpha_{t}]=M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})</annotation></semantics></math>, we have</p>

<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lipschitz continuity and sign alignment:</span>
Assume there exists <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{Lip}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow></msub><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">L_{Lip}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math> such that for all <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a\in\mathcal{A}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒜</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a\in\mathcal{A}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2}\in[-\gamma,1+\gamma]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2}\in[-\gamma,1+\gamma]</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>
<table id="A1.Ex34" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.Ex34.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\big|M(\alpha_{2}\mid a)-M(\alpha_{1}\mid a)\big|\leq L_{Lip}\,|\alpha_{2}-\alpha_{1}|." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" stretchy="true">|</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\big|M(\alpha_{2}\mid a)-M(\alpha_{1}\mid a)\big|\leq L_{Lip}\,|\alpha_{2}-\alpha_{1}|.</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.2" class="ltx_p">Taking <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{1}=\alpha_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{1}=\alpha_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{2}=\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{2}=\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}</annotation></semantics></math> and using <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\mid A_{t})=\alpha" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\mid A_{t})=\alpha</annotation></semantics></math> gives</p>
<table id="A1.EGx2" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A1.Ex36"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Moreover, <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p3.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="M(\cdot\mid A_{t})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M(\cdot\mid A_{t})</annotation></semantics></math> is nondecreasing with <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\mid A_{t})=\alpha" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\mid A_{t})=\alpha</annotation></semantics></math>, hence</p>

Using (<a href="#A1.E37" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">37</span></a>) in the squared expansion, we get</p>

Summing (<a href="#A1.E39" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">39</span></a>) over <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t=1,\dots,T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t=1,\dots,T</annotation></semantics></math> and dividing by <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p6.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>

<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">Since <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\texttt{err}_{t}\in\{0,1\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_monospace">err</mtext><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\texttt{err}_{t}\in\{0,1\}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p7.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha\in[0,1]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha\in[0,1]</annotation></semantics></math>, we have <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p7.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha-\texttt{err}_{t})^{2}\leq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_monospace">err</mtext><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>≤</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\alpha-\texttt{err}_{t})^{2}\leq 1</annotation></semantics></math>, hence</p>
<table id="A1.E41" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="true">⏟</mo></munder><mtext>(II)</mtext></munder></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\quad=\;\underbrace{\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\Big\{\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{t}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}\right]-\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}})^{2}\right]\Big\}}_{\text{(I)}}\;+\;\underbrace{\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}})^{2}-(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}\right]}_{\text{(II)}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(42)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">(I) term:</span>
Reindexing the second sum in (I) by <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s=t+\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s=t+\tau</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.Ex40.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}})^{2}\right]=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{s=\tau+1}^{T+\tau}\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{s}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{s}})^{2}\right]." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>T</mi></munderover><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></munderover><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}})^{2}\right]=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{s=\tau+1}^{T+\tau}\mathbb{E}\!\left[(\alpha_{s}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{s}})^{2}\right].</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.2" class="ltx_p">Hence,</p>

<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.3" class="ltx_p">Because <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{t}\in[-\gamma,1+\gamma]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{t}\in[-\gamma,1+\gamma]</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\in(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\in(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math>, the squared terms <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha_{t}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\alpha_{t}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> are bounded
by <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(1+\gamma)^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1+\gamma)^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\text{(I)}=O(\tau/T)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mtext>(I)</mtext><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>O</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{(I)}=O(\tau/T)</annotation></semantics></math>. Under stationarity, letting <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p9.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\to\infty" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\to\infty</annotation></semantics></math> gives</p>
<table id="A1.E44" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E44.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\text{(I)}\;\xrightarrow[T\to\infty]{}\;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mtext>(I)</mtext><munderover accent="true" accentunder="true"><mo lspace="0.558em">→</mo><mrow><mi mathsize="0.700em">T</mi><mo mathsize="0.700em" stretchy="false">→</mo><mi mathsize="0.700em" mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><mphantom></mphantom></munderover><mn> 0</mn></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{(I)}\;\xrightarrow[T\to\infty]{}\;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(44)</span></td></tr></tbody>

<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p10.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">(II) term.</span>
For each <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p10.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>

alttext="(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}})^{2}-(\alpha_{t+\tau}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}=2\alpha_{t+\tau}\Big(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}}\Big)-\Big((\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}-(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}})^{2}\Big)" <p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p10.2" class="ltx_p">Hence,</p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(46)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>

<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">Because <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\in(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\in(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math>, the squared terms <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}})^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> are bounded
by <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>1</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>, so (<a href="#A1.E47" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">47</span></a>) <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="=O(\tau/T)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>O</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=O(\tau/T)</annotation></semantics></math>. Under stationarity, letting <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\to\infty" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\to\infty</annotation></semantics></math> gives (<a href="#A1.E47" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">47</span></a>) <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p13.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\;\xrightarrow[T\to\infty]{}\;0." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><munderover accent="true" accentunder="true"><mo>→</mo><mrow><mi mathsize="0.700em">T</mi><mo mathsize="0.700em" stretchy="false">→</mo><mi mathsize="0.700em" mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><mphantom></mphantom></munderover><mn> 0</mn></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\;\xrightarrow[T\to\infty]{}\;0.</annotation></semantics></math>
<br class="ltx_break"></p>

<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p14.1" class="ltx_p"><em id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p14.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">The first term in <span id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p14.1.1.1" class="ltx_text">(II)</span></em>: Since <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p14.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{t+\tau}\in[-\gamma,1+\gamma]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{t+\tau}\in[-\gamma,1+\gamma]</annotation></semantics></math></p>

<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p15.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Let <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p15.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\to\infty" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\to\infty</annotation></semantics></math> and conclude:</span>
Combine (<a href="#A1.E40" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">40</span></a>), (<a href="#A1.E41" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">41</span></a>), the vanishing of (I), the vanishing of the second term in (II), and (<a href="#A1.E48" title='In Bounding the cross term 𝔼[(𝛼-"err"_𝑡)⁢(𝛼_𝑡-𝛼^∗_𝐴_𝑡)]: ‣ A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">48</span></a>), then let <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p15.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\to\infty" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\to\infty</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="A1.EGx11" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A1.E49"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E49.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{2\gamma}{L_{Lip}}\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[(M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})-\alpha)^{2}\right]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{2\gamma}{L_{Lip}}\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[(M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})-\alpha)^{2}\right]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E49.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq 2(1+\gamma)\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[\big|\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\big|\right]+\gamma^{2}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" stretchy="true">|</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq 2(1+\gamma)\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[\big|\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\big|\right]+\gamma^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(49)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p15.2" class="ltx_p">Hence,</p>
<table id="A1.E50" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E50.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\boxed{\;\mathbb{E}\!\left[(M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})-\alpha)^{2}\right]\;\leq\;\frac{L_{Lip}(1+\gamma)}{\gamma}\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[\big|\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\big|\right]\;+\;\frac{L_{Lip}}{2}\,\gamma.\;}" display="block" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo rspace="0.280em">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em"
