lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{\;\mathbb{E}\!\left[(M(\alpha_{t}\mid A_{t})-\alpha)^{2}\right]\;\leq\;\frac{L_{Lip}(1+\gamma)}{\gamma}\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[\big|\alpha^{*}_{A_{t+\tau}}-\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}\big|\right]\;+\;\frac{L_{Lip}}{2}\,\gamma.\;}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(50)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">This is the stated bound in Theorem <a href="#A1.SS3" title="A.3 Approximate Marginal Coverage ‣ Appendix A Proofs for Coverage Guarantees Under Delayed Feedback ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">A.3</span></a>. Intuitively, the first term measures the <em id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">distribution shift</em> across <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>τ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau</annotation></semantics></math> steps by the change in the optimal level <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>α</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha^{*}_{A_{t}}</annotation></semantics></math>, and the second term is the <em id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16.1.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">adaptation penalty</em> controlled by the step size <math id="A1.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p16.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>γ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\gamma</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process</h2>

<section id="A2.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.1 </span>Autocorrelation of the two-state regime indicator</h3>

<div id="A2.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">This appendix derives <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Corr}(A_{t},A_{t+k})=\lambda_{2}^{\,k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Corr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Corr}(A_{t},A_{t+k})=\lambda_{2}^{\,k}</annotation></semantics></math> for the two-state
regime indicator <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}\in\{0,1\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}\in\{0,1\}</annotation></semantics></math> used in Section <a href="#S6" title="6 Simulated Residual Processes and Diagnostic Framework ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">6</span></a>, starting
from the transition matrix.</p>
</div>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 1: Eigenvalues</h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The transition matrix is</p>
<table id="A2.Ex44" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex44.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P=\begin{pmatrix}p_{00}&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1-p_{11}&amp;p_{11}\end{pmatrix}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mtd><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow></mtd><mtd><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P=\begin{pmatrix}p_{00}&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1-p_{11}&amp;p_{11}\end{pmatrix}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Since <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>P</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P</annotation></semantics></math> is row-stochastic, <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P\mathbf{1}=\mathbf{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mn>𝟏</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>𝟏</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P\mathbf{1}=\mathbf{1}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{1}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{1}=1</annotation></semantics></math> is an eigenvalue
with eigenvector <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{1}=(1,1)^{\top}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>𝟏</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{1}=(1,1)^{\top}</annotation></semantics></math>. The characteristic polynomial of a
<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2\times 2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\times 2</annotation></semantics></math> matrix is <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda^{2}-\operatorname{tr}(P)\lambda+\det(P)=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>tr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>P</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>λ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">det</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>P</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda^{2}-\operatorname{tr}(P)\lambda+\det(P)=0</annotation></semantics></math>, so the two
eigenvalues satisfy <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{1}+\lambda_{2}=\operatorname{tr}(P)=p_{00}+p_{11}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>tr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>P</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{1}+\lambda_{2}=\operatorname{tr}(P)=p_{00}+p_{11}</annotation></semantics></math>. With
<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{1}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{1}=1</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex45" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex45.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}=p_{00}+p_{11}-1." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}=p_{00}+p_{11}-1.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 2: Eigenvectors</h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The eigenvector for <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{1}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{1}=1</annotation></semantics></math> is <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{1}=(1,1)^{\top}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v_{1}=(1,1)^{\top}</annotation></semantics></math>, as above. For <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}</annotation></semantics></math>,
solve <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(P-\lambda_{2}I)v=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(P-\lambda_{2}I)v=0</annotation></semantics></math>. Using <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p_{00}-\lambda_{2}=1-p_{11}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p_{00}-\lambda_{2}=1-p_{11}</annotation></semantics></math> and
<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p_{11}-\lambda_{2}=1-p_{00}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p_{11}-\lambda_{2}=1-p_{00}</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex46" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex46.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P-\lambda_{2}I=\begin{pmatrix}1-p_{11}&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1-p_{11}&amp;1-p_{00}\end{pmatrix}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow></mtd><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow></mtd><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P-\lambda_{2}I=\begin{pmatrix}1-p_{11}&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1-p_{11}&amp;1-p_{00}\end{pmatrix},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">which has identical rows (confirming <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\det(P-\lambda_{2}I)=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo rspace="0em">det</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\det(P-\lambda_{2}I)=0</annotation></semantics></math>), giving</p>
<table id="A2.Ex47" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex47.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{2}=\begin{pmatrix}1-p_{00}\\
-(1-p_{11})\end{pmatrix}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v_{2}=\begin{pmatrix}1-p_{00}\\
-(1-p_{11})\end{pmatrix}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.3" class="ltx_p">Writing <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V=(v_{1}\mid v_{2})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V=(v_{1}\mid v_{2})</annotation></semantics></math>, we have</p>
<table id="A2.Ex48" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex48.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V=\big(v_{1}\mid v_{2}\big)=\begin{pmatrix}1&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1&amp;-(1-p_{11})\end{pmatrix}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V=\big(v_{1}\mid v_{2}\big)=\begin{pmatrix}1&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1&amp;-(1-p_{11})\end{pmatrix}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.4" class="ltx_p"><math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>V</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V</annotation></semantics></math> is invertible, with</p>
<table id="A2.Ex49" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex49.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V^{-1}=\frac{1}{D}\begin{pmatrix}1-p_{11}&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1&amp;-1\end{pmatrix}" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>D</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow></mtd><mtd><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V^{-1}=\frac{1}{D}\begin{pmatrix}1-p_{11}&amp;1-p_{00}\\
1&amp;-1\end{pmatrix}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.5" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D:=(2-p_{00}-p_{11})&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D:=(2-p_{00}-p_{11})&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 3: Closed form of <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>P</mi><mi>k</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P^{k}</annotation></semantics></math></h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Let <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(1,\lambda_{2})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Λ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(1,\lambda_{2})</annotation></semantics></math>. The eigendecomposition
<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P=V\Lambda V^{-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Λ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P=V\Lambda V^{-1}</annotation></semantics></math> gives</p>
<table id="A2.Ex50" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex50.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P^{k}=V\Lambda^{k}V^{-1}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>P</mi><mi>k</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Λ</mi><mi>k</mi></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P^{k}=V\Lambda^{k}V^{-1}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Carrying out the multiplication and substituting the stationary distribution</p>
<table id="A2.Ex51" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex51.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pi_{0}=\frac{1-p_{11}}{D},\qquad\pi_{1}=\frac{1-p_{00}}{D}" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>11</mn></msub></mrow><mi>D</mi></mfrac></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>00</mn></msub></mrow><mi>D</mi></mfrac></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi_{0}=\frac{1-p_{11}}{D},\qquad\pi_{1}=\frac{1-p_{00}}{D}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.3" class="ltx_p">gives</p>
<table id="A2.Ex52" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex52.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P^{k}=\begin{pmatrix}\pi_{0}+\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}&amp;\pi_{1}(1-\lambda_{2}^{k})\\
\pi_{0}(1-\lambda_{2}^{k})&amp;\pi_{1}+\pi_{0}\lambda_{2}^{k}\end{pmatrix}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>P</mi><mi>k</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mtd><mtd><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mtd><mtd><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P^{k}=\begin{pmatrix}\pi_{0}+\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}&amp;\pi_{1}(1-\lambda_{2}^{k})\\
\pi_{0}(1-\lambda_{2}^{k})&amp;\pi_{1}+\pi_{0}\lambda_{2}^{k}\end{pmatrix}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.4" class="ltx_p">Every row sums to one, as required.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 4: Moments of <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math></h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Under stationarity, <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> is Bernoulli with success probability <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pi_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi_{1}</annotation></semantics></math>.
Therefore,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex53" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex53.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[A_{t}]=\pi_{1},\qquad\operatorname{Var}(A_{t})=\pi_{1}(1-\pi_{1})=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[A_{t}]=\pi_{1},\qquad\operatorname{Var}(A_{t})=\pi_{1}(1-\pi_{1})=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 5: Joint expectation</h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Because <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}A_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}A_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math> equals one only when both indicators equal one,</p>
<table id="A2.EGx12" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.Ex54"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex54.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbb{E}[A_{t}A_{t+k}]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbb{E}[A_{t}A_{t+k}]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex54.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\Pr(A_{t}=1,A_{t+k}=1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\Pr(A_{t}=1,A_{t+k}=1)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.Ex55"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex55.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\Pr(A_{t}=1)\Pr(A_{t+k}=1\mid A_{t}=1)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\Pr(A_{t}=1)\Pr(A_{t+k}=1\mid A_{t}=1).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px5.p1.2" class="ltx_p">The second probability is the lower-right entry of <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>P</mi><mi>k</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>. Hence,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex56" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex56.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[A_{t}A_{t+k}]=\pi_{1}\left(\pi_{1}+\pi_{0}\lambda_{2}^{k}\right)=\pi_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[A_{t}A_{t+k}]=\pi_{1}\left(\pi_{1}+\pi_{0}\lambda_{2}^{k}\right)=\pi_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px6" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 6: Covariance</h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">By stationarity,
<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px6.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[A_{t}]=\mathbb{E}[A_{t+k}]=\pi_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[A_{t}]=\mathbb{E}[A_{t+k}]=\pi_{1}</annotation></semantics></math>. It follows that</p>
<table id="A2.EGx13" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.Ex57"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex57.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{Cov}(A_{t},A_{t+k})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{Cov}(A_{t},A_{t+k})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex57.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}[A_{t}A_{t+k}]-\mathbb{E}[A_{t}]\mathbb{E}[A_{t+k}]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}[A_{t}A_{t+k}]-\mathbb{E}[A_{t}]\mathbb{E}[A_{t+k}]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.Ex58"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex58.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\left(\pi_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}\right)-\pi_{1}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\left(\pi_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}\right)-\pi_{1}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.Ex59"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex59.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 7: Correlation</h4>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">By stationarity,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex60" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex60.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Var}(A_{t})=\operatorname{Var}(A_{t+k})=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Var}(A_{t})=\operatorname{Var}(A_{t+k})=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Therefore,</p>
<table id="A2.EGx14" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.Ex61"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex61.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{Corr}(A_{t},A_{t+k})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Corr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{Corr}(A_{t},A_{t+k})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex61.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(A_{t},A_{t+k})}{\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(A_{t})\operatorname{Var}(A_{t+k})}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><msqrt><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></msqrt></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(A_{t},A_{t+k})}{\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(A_{t})\operatorname{Var}(A_{t+k})}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.Ex62"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex62.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}}{\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}}{\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.Ex63"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex63.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k\geq 0." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k\geq 0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.3" class="ltx_p">The factor <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pi_{0}\pi_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi_{0}\pi_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> cancels between the covariance and the
normalization. Thus, the latent state indicator has no attenuation factor:
its autocorrelation is exactly <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>. If <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>, as in
the transition matrices used in our experiments, the autocorrelation decays
monotonically. More generally, a negative <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}</annotation></semantics></math> produces an
alternating sign, while its magnitude decays as <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px7.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\lambda_{2}|^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>k</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\lambda_{2}|^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.2 </span>Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features</h3>

<div id="A2.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">This section derives how the dependence in the latent regime process induces
dependence in the residuals and their transformations. The derivation applies to the
mean-switching, variance-switching, and joint-switching residual families considered in
Section <a href="#S6" title="6 Simulated Residual Processes and Diagnostic Framework ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">6</span></a>.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
<section id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 1: State-dependent conditional means</h4>

<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Let</p>
<table id="A2.Ex64" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex64.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=g(\varepsilon_{t})" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=g(\varepsilon_{t})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.2" class="ltx_p">denote a transformation of the residual with a finite second moment. Define its
state-dependent conditional mean by</p>
<table id="A2.Ex65" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex65.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{j}:=\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}=j],\qquad j\in\{0,1\}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{j}:=\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}=j],\qquad j\in\{0,1\}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.3" class="ltx_p">Because <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> is binary, the conditional mean of <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> can be written as</p>
<table id="A2.Ex66" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex66.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}]=m_{0}+(m_{1}-m_{0})A_{t}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}]=m_{0}+(m_{1}-m_{0})A_{t}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.4" class="ltx_p">This expression equals <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{0}</annotation></semantics></math> when <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}=0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> when <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}=1</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 2: Law of total covariance</h4>

<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>, apply the law of total covariance with <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math>, and the conditioning variable <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Z=(A_{t},A_{t+k})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Z=(A_{t},A_{t+k})</annotation></semantics></math>, a random vector containing the states at both time points. Because <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t},A_{t+k}\in\{0,1\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t},A_{t+k}\in\{0,1\}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Z" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>Z</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Z</annotation></semantics></math> takes one of the four possible values <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)</annotation></semantics></math>. The law of total covariance gives</p>
<table id="A2.EGx15" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.Ex67"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex67.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{Cov}(Y_{t},Y_{t+k})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{Cov}(Y_{t},Y_{t+k})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex67.m2" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\operatorname{Cov}\left(Y_{t},Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}\right)\right]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo>[</mo><mi>Cov</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\operatorname{Cov}\left(Y_{t},Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}\right)\right]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.Ex68"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex68.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\displaystyle\quad+\operatorname{Cov}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}],\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}]\right)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mpadded style="width:1.622em;" width="1.622em"><mi>Cov</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\quad+\operatorname{Cov}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}],\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}]\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Conditional on <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math>, the residual features at the two time points can be written as</p>
<table id="A2.Ex69" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex69.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=g\!\left(\mu_{A_{t}}+\sigma_{A_{t}}\eta_{t}\right),\qquad Y_{t+k}=g\!\left(\mu_{A_{t+k}}+\sigma_{A_{t+k}}\eta_{t+k}\right)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.343em;" width="0.343em"><mi>g</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.343em;" width="0.343em"><mi>g</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=g\!\left(\mu_{A_{t}}+\sigma_{A_{t}}\eta_{t}\right),\qquad Y_{t+k}=g\!\left(\mu_{A_{t+k}}+\sigma_{A_{t+k}}\eta_{t+k}\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.2" class="ltx_p">The noise variables <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>η</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math> are independent. Therefore,
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math> are conditionally independent once <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math> are fixed, and</p>
<table id="A2.Ex70" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex70.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}\left(Y_{t},Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}\right)=0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}\left(Y_{t},Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}\right)=0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2.3" class="ltx_p">The first term in the total-covariance decomposition is consequently zero.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Once <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> is known, knowledge of <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math> provides no additional information about <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>, because the conditional distribution of <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> depends only on the state at time <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>. Similarly, once <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math> is known, knowledge of <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> provides no additional information about <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t+k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t+k}</annotation></semantics></math>. Hence,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex71" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex71.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}]=\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}]=m_{A_{t}}\qquad\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}]=\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t+k}]=m_{A_{t+k}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msub><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub></msub><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}]=\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}]=m_{A_{t}}\qquad\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t},A_{t+k}]=\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+k}\mid A_{t+k}]=m_{A_{t+k}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p3.2" class="ltx_p">The law of total covariance therefore reduces to</p>

<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p4.1" class="ltx_p">From Section <a href="#A2.SS1" title="B.1 Autocorrelation of the two-state regime indicator ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">B.1</span></a>,</p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex75.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(A_{t},A_{t+k})=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(A_{t},A_{t+k})=\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p4.2" class="ltx_p">Therefore,</p>
<table id="A2.E51" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E51.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(Y_{t},Y_{t+k})=(m_{1}-m_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(Y_{t},Y_{t+k})=(m_{1}-m_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(51)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p4.3" class="ltx_p">This is the two-state specialization of the general hidden Markov model moment formula
in <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citet"><a href="#bib.bib17" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zucchini and MacDonald (2009, Exercise 3(e)–(f), p. 42)</a></cite>. Any residual feature whose
conditional mean differs between the two states therefore inherits the geometric factor
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 3: Autocorrelation and attenuation</h4>

<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Let</p>
<table id="A2.Ex76" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex76.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{Y}:=\operatorname{Var}(Y_{t})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{Y}:=\operatorname{Var}(Y_{t}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">By stationarity,
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Var}(Y_{t+k})=V_{Y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Var}(Y_{t+k})=V_{Y}</annotation></semantics></math>, so dividing
Equation (<a href="#A2.E51" title="In Step 2: Law of total covariance ‣ B.2 Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">51</span></a>) by <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{Y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{Y}</annotation></semantics></math> gives</p>
<table id="A2.E52" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E52.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Corr}(Y_{t},Y_{t+k})=c_{Y}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad c_{Y}:=\frac{(m_{1}-m_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}{V_{Y}},\qquad k&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Corr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub></mfrac></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Corr}(Y_{t},Y_{t+k})=c_{Y}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad c_{Y}:=\frac{(m_{1}-m_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}{V_{Y}},\qquad k&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(52)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.3" class="ltx_p">The numerator of <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{Y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{Y}</annotation></semantics></math> is</p>
<table id="A2.Ex77" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex77.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}]\right)=(m_{1}-m_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.643em;" width="1.643em"><mi>Var</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[Y_{t}\mid A_{t}]\right)=(m_{1}-m_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.4" class="ltx_p">Thus, <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{Y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{Y}</annotation></semantics></math> is the fraction of the variance of <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> attributable to differences
in its conditional mean between the two states. It changes the magnitude of the
autocorrelation but not its geometric decay factor.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 4: Mean-switching residuals</h4>

<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For the mean-switching model,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex78" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex78.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\varepsilon_{t}=\mu_{0}+\Delta A_{t}+\eta_{t},\qquad\Delta:=\mu_{1}-\mu_{0},\qquad\eta_{t}\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal{N}(0,1)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>:=</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mover accent="true"><mo>∼</mo><mo mathsize="0.700em">iid</mo></mover><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varepsilon_{t}=\mu_{0}+\Delta A_{t}+\eta_{t},\qquad\Delta:=\mu_{1}-\mu_{0},\qquad\eta_{t}\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal{N}(0,1),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{\eta_{t}\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{\eta_{t}\}</annotation></semantics></math> is independent of the state process. Taking
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>, the state-dependent conditional means are</p>
<table id="A2.Ex79" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex79.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{0}=\mu_{0},\qquad m_{1}=\mu_{1}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{0}=\mu_{0},\qquad m_{1}=\mu_{1},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.3" class="ltx_p">so <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{1}-m_{0}=\Delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{1}-m_{0}=\Delta</annotation></semantics></math>. Equation (<a href="#A2.E51" title="In Step 2: Law of total covariance ‣ B.2 Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">51</span></a>) gives</p>

<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(53)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.4" class="ltx_p">Because</p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.5" class="ltx_p">the positive-lag autocorrelation is</p>
<table id="A2.E54" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(54)</span></td></tr></tbody>

<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.6" class="ltx_p">The independent Gaussian noise reduces the magnitude of the residual autocorrelation
but does not change its geometric decay factor.</p>
