</section>
<section id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 5: Variance-switching residuals</h4>

<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For the variance-switching model,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex81" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex81.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varepsilon_{t}=\sigma_{A_{t}}\eta_{t},\qquad\eta_{t}\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal{N}(0,1)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mo>∼</mo><mo mathsize="0.700em">iid</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varepsilon_{t}=\sigma_{A_{t}}\eta_{t},\qquad\eta_{t}\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal{N}(0,1),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.2" class="ltx_p">with <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mu_{0}=\mu_{1}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mu_{0}=\mu_{1}=0</annotation></semantics></math>. Taking <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> gives</p>
<table id="A2.Ex82" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex82.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{0}=m_{1}=0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{0}=m_{1}=0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.3" class="ltx_p">Equation (<a href="#A2.E51" title="In Step 2: Law of total covariance ‣ B.2 Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">51</span></a>) therefore gives</p>
<table id="A2.E55" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E55.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(\varepsilon_{t},\varepsilon_{t+k})=0,\qquad k&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(\varepsilon_{t},\varepsilon_{t+k})=0,\qquad k&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(55)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.4" class="ltx_p">Thus, the signed residuals are serially uncorrelated even though they are not
independent. Their linear autocorrelation does not detect the regime dependence because
the conditional residual mean is zero in both states.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Taking <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have</p>
<table id="A2.Ex83" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex83.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{j}=\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_{t}^{2}\mid A_{t}=j]=\sigma_{j}^{2}\mathbb{E}[\eta_{t}^{2}]=\sigma_{j}^{2}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{j}=\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_{t}^{2}\mid A_{t}=j]=\sigma_{j}^{2}\mathbb{E}[\eta_{t}^{2}]=\sigma_{j}^{2},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.2" class="ltx_p">because <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[\eta_{t}^{2}]=\operatorname{Var}(\eta_{t})+\mathbb{E}[\eta_{t}]^{2}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[\eta_{t}^{2}]=\operatorname{Var}(\eta_{t})+\mathbb{E}[\eta_{t}]^{2}=1</annotation></semantics></math>.
Thus,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex84" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex84.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{1}-m_{0}=\sigma_{1}^{2}-\sigma_{0}^{2}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{1}-m_{0}=\sigma_{1}^{2}-\sigma_{0}^{2},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.3" class="ltx_p">and Equation (<a href="#A2.E51" title="In Step 2: Law of total covariance ‣ B.2 Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">51</span></a>) gives</p>
<table id="A2.E56" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>

</table>
<br class="ltx_break">
</div>
<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Similarly, taking <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=|\varepsilon_{t}|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=|\varepsilon_{t}|</annotation></semantics></math>, we have</p>
<table id="A2.Ex85" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex85.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{j}=\mathbb{E}[|\varepsilon_{t}|\mid A_{t}=j]=\sigma_{j}\mathbb{E}[|\eta_{t}|]=\sigma_{j}\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mfrac></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{j}=\mathbb{E}[|\varepsilon_{t}|\mid A_{t}=j]=\sigma_{j}\mathbb{E}[|\eta_{t}|]=\sigma_{j}\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[|\eta_{t}|]=\sqrt{2/\pi}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>/</mo><mi>π</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[|\eta_{t}|]=\sqrt{2/\pi}</annotation></semantics></math> for
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta_{t}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta_{t}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math>. Thus,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex86" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex86.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{1}-m_{0}=(\sigma_{1}-\sigma_{0})\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mfrac></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{1}-m_{0}=(\sigma_{1}-\sigma_{0})\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.3" class="ltx_p">and</p>
<table id="A2.E57" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E57.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(|\varepsilon_{t}|,|\varepsilon_{t+k}|)=\frac{2}{\pi}(\sigma_{1}-\sigma_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(|\varepsilon_{t}|,|\varepsilon_{t+k}|)=\frac{2}{\pi}(\sigma_{1}-\sigma_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(57)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<br class="ltx_break">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p3.4" class="ltx_p">Both the absolute and squared residuals reveal the regime dependence that is absent
from the autocorrelation of the signed residuals.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 6: Joint-switching residuals</h4>

<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For the joint-switching model,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex87" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex87.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varepsilon_{t}=\mu_{A_{t}}+\sigma_{A_{t}}\eta_{t}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msub><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varepsilon_{t}=\mu_{A_{t}}+\sigma_{A_{t}}\eta_{t},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.2" class="ltx_p">so both the conditional mean and conditional variance depend on the state. Taking
<math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y_{t}=\varepsilon_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> in Equation (<a href="#A2.E51" title="In Step 2: Law of total covariance ‣ B.2 Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">51</span></a>) gives</p>
<table id="A2.E58" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E58.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(\varepsilon_{t},\varepsilon_{t+k})=(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(\varepsilon_{t},\varepsilon_{t+k})=(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(58)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.3" class="ltx_p">By the law of total variance,</p>
<table id="A2.Ex88" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex88.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t})=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t})\right]+\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t}]\right)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.643em;" width="1.643em"><mi>Var</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t})=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t})\right]+\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t}]\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.4" class="ltx_p">The first term is</p>
<table id="A2.EGx17" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.Ex89"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex89.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\!\left[\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t})\right]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\!\left[\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t})\right]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex89.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\sum_{j=0}^{1}\Pr(A_{t}=j)\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t}=j)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></munderover></mstyle><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\sum_{j=0}^{1}\Pr(A_{t}=j)\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t}=j)</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.5" class="ltx_p">The second term is</p>

<tbody id="A2.Ex91"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex91.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t}]\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.643em;" width="1.643em"><mi>Var</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_{t}\mid A_{t}]\right)</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.6" class="ltx_p">Therefore,</p>
<table id="A2.E59" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E59.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t})=\pi_{0}\sigma_{0}^{2}+\pi_{1}\sigma_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Var}(\varepsilon_{t})=\pi_{0}\sigma_{0}^{2}+\pi_{1}\sigma_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(59)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.7" class="ltx_p">The first two terms represent the average variance within the two states, while the
final term represents the variance of the state-dependent conditional mean.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Therefore,</p>
<table id="A2.E60" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E60.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Corr}(\varepsilon_{t},\varepsilon_{t+k})=\frac{(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}{\pi_{0}\sigma_{0}^{2}+\pi_{1}\sigma_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Corr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Corr}(\varepsilon_{t},\varepsilon_{t+k})=\frac{(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}{\pi_{0}\sigma_{0}^{2}+\pi_{1}\sigma_{1}^{2}+\pi_{0}\pi_{1}(\mu_{1}-\mu_{0})^{2}}\lambda_{2}^{k},\qquad k&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(60)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2.2" class="ltx_p">The state-dependent variance changes the attenuation coefficient but not the geometric
factor <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>.
<br class="ltx_break"></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Table <a href="#A2.T8" title="Table 8 ‣ Step 6: Joint-switching residuals ‣ B.2 Autocorrelation of state-dependent residual features ‣ Appendix B Autocorrelation Structure of the Markov-Switching Process ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a> summarizes the resulting positive-lag autocorrelation structure. The attenuation coefficient <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{Y}\leq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub><mo>≤</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{Y}\leq 1</annotation></semantics></math> affects only the magnitude of the observed-feature autocorrelation, while the geometric decay rate remains <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{2}^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{2}^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>. In particular, under variance switching, the signed residual is uncorrelated across time, while <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\varepsilon_{t}|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\varepsilon_{t}|</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varepsilon_{t}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>ε</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varepsilon_{t}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> retain the latent regime dependence.</p>
</div>

<td id="A2.T8.5.4.3" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-bottom: 8.53581pt;"><math id="A2.T8.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle c_{|\varepsilon|}=\frac{\frac{2}{\pi}(\sigma_{1}-\sigma_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}{V_{|\varepsilon|}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">c</mi><mrow><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em" stretchy="true">|</mo><mi mathsize="0.900em">ε</mi><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow></msub><mo mathsize="0.900em">=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mfrac><mn mathsize="0.900em">2</mn><mi mathsize="0.900em">π</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">σ</mi><mn mathsize="0.900em">1</mn></msub><mo mathsize="0.900em">−</mo><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">σ</mi><mn mathsize="0.900em">0</mn></msub></mrow><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em">)</mo></mrow><mn mathsize="0.900em">2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">π</mi><mn mathsize="0.900em">0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">π</mi><mn mathsize="0.900em">1</mn></msub></mrow><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">V</mi><mrow><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em" stretchy="true">|</mo><mi mathsize="0.900em">ε</mi><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow></msub></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle c_{|\varepsilon|}=\frac{\frac{2}{\pi}(\sigma_{1}-\sigma_{0})^{2}\pi_{0}\pi_{1}}{V_{|\varepsilon|}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td id="A2.T8.5.4.4" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-bottom: 8.53581pt;"><math id="A2.T8.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{|\varepsilon|}\lambda_{2}^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathsize="0.900em">c</mi><mrow><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em" stretchy="true">|</mo><mi mathsize="0.900em">ε</mi><mo maxsize="0.900em" minsize="0.900em" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi mathsize="0.900em">λ</mi><mn mathsize="0.900em">2</mn><mi mathsize="0.900em">k</mi></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{|\varepsilon|}\lambda_{2}^{k}</annotation></semantics></math></td></tr>

<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix C </span>Additional Results</h2>

<section id="A3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.1 </span>AR(1)</h3>

<div id="A3.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Figure <a href="#A3.F12" title="Figure 12 ‣ C.1 AR(1) ‣ Appendix C Additional Results ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">12</span></a> reports the worst-case local coverage error at the interval-score-optimal step size <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>γ</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\gamma^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> as a function of delay-to-memory ratio <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>ε</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon}</annotation></semantics></math> for both window lengths. Within each persistence level, the error generally increases with <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>ε</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon}</annotation></semantics></math>, indicating that local calibration deteriorates as the delay grows relative to the memory length. Unlike the achieved interval score, however, the curves do not collapse across <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varphi" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>φ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varphi</annotation></semantics></math>. Instead, they remain vertically separated, with stronger persistence associated with larger local coverage error over the overlapping range of <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>ε</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon}</annotation></semantics></math>. Thus, <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>ε</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon}</annotation></semantics></math> organizes the variation in local coverage error within a persistence level, but does not account for its magnitude across persistence levels, which remains strongly dependent on <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varphi" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>φ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varphi</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A3.F12" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2609.07251v1/figures/Delayed_ACI/ar_LCE_at_IS_optimum_vs_r.png" id="A3.F12.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:476/189;" width="476" height="189" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A3.F12.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 12</span>: </span><span id="A3.F12.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Worst-case local coverage error at the approximately score-minimizing step size
<math id="A3.F12.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>γ</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\gamma^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> for AR(1) residuals, against the delay-to-memory ratio
<math id="A3.F12.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>ε</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon}</annotation></semantics></math>, for window lengths <math id="A3.F12.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=100" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=100</annotation></semantics></math> (left) and <math id="A3.F12.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=250" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=250</annotation></semantics></math> (right).</span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.2 </span>GARCH(1,1)</h3>

<div id="A3.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Figure <a href="#A3.F13" title="Figure 13 ‣ C.2 GARCH(1,1) ‣ Appendix C Additional Results ‣ Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">13</span></a> compares the worst-case local coverage error of the unnormalized and current-scale oracle normalized constructions for window lengths <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=100" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=100</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=250" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=250</annotation></semantics></math>. Normalization reduces local coverage error across nearly all configurations, with the only exceptions occurring at <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau=1</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha+\beta=0.9" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0.9</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha+\beta=0.9</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha+\beta=0.95" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0.95</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha+\beta=0.95</annotation></semantics></math>. The gains are most pronounced for the more persistent processes: for <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha+\beta=0.95" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0.95</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha+\beta=0.95</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha+\beta=0.99" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0.99</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha+\beta=0.99</annotation></semantics></math>, normalization substantially attenuates the increase in local coverage error as <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon^{2}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><msup><mi>ε</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon^{2}}</annotation></semantics></math> grows. Local coverage errors are lower for <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=250" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=250</annotation></semantics></math> than for <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=100" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=100</annotation></semantics></math>, but the qualitative benefit of normalization is consistent across both window lengths. Notably, the current-scale oracle retains a local-coverage advantage even when its interval-score advantage disappears for <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon^{2}}\gtrsim 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><msup><mi>ε</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></msub><mo>≳</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon^{2}}\gtrsim 1</annotation></semantics></math>. This suggests that the delay-induced mismatch in conditional scale affects interval efficiency more strongly than local coverage stability.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A3.F13" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2609.07251v1/figures/Delayed_ACI/garch_normal_LCE_unnorm_vs_norm.png" id="A3.F13.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:476/210;" width="476" height="210" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A3.F13.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 13</span>: </span><span id="A3.F13.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Worst-case local coverage error at the approximately score-minimizing
step-size <math id="A3.F13.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>γ</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\gamma^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> for GARCH(1,1) residuals, against the
delay-to-memory ratio <math id="A3.F13.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\varepsilon^{2}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><msup><mi>ε</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\varepsilon^{2}}</annotation></semantics></math>, for
window lengths <math id="A3.F13.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=100" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=100</annotation></semantics></math> (left) and <math id="A3.F13.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=250" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=250</annotation></semantics></math> (right). Solid lines use the unnormalized-residual construction and dashed lines use the current-scale oracle normalization.</span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.3 </span>Mean and Variance Shift</h3>

<figure id="A3.F14" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2609.07251v1/figures/Delayed_ACI/shift_combined_multishift__coverage_width_stacked_mean_window20.png" id="A3.F14.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:476/270;" width="476" height="270" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A3.F14.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 14</span>: </span><span id="A3.F14.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Rolling coverage (top) and interval width (bottom) along the combined mean-shift trajectory using calibration-window length <math id="A3.F14.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R=250" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R=250</annotation></semantics></math>. Rolling quantities are computed over a window of <math id="A3.F14.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math> observations.</span></figcaption>
</figure>
